protocol.ci: 2000 percentile bootstrap resamples of independent held-out seed means; paired deltas reuse the same datasets. Intervals are exploratory, without correction for the reported conditions.
protocol.encoding: Correlated random-Fourier entity phase codes bound to random attribute codes; random value codebook; unique entity/attribute facts; query keys and locations share the same independently generated cue corruption across arms.
protocol.geometry: Fixed ambient 3-neighbor topology; metric c=0 or c=1 and connection c=0 or c=1 varied independently. Both data layouts use isotropic ambient-coordinate cue noise; hierarchy coordinates are a constructed Poincare tree, not learned embeddings.
protocol.memory: Model payload bytes include graph, raw complex128 field, immutable readout field, phase value codebook/LUT, and source witnesses. Harness fixtures, allocator overhead and process RSS are excluded. Snapshot construction workspace is reported separately; f64 amplitudes and u16 phases are not packed low-bit storage.
protocol.promotion_rule: Geometry must improve held-out exact value recall over the tuned flat arm with positive paired CI, with both metric and transport ablations contributing. A synthetic win alone cannot meet the proposed 2x facts/total-byte product target.
protocol.selection: Each arm tunes the same bandwidth/tau grid on calibration seeds only; ties select the first setting. Held-out seeds begin at seed + 10000. Every tried setting is retained.
protocol.timing: Local unpaired indicative wall-clock samples include footprint, unbinding and full value-codebook cleanup; snapshot build/relaxation is charged separately. These are not load-gated competitor speed claims.

scope: Synthetic static geometry and quantized U(1) transport only; no neural training, production integration, text-answer accuracy, or competitor superiority measured.
